cards.text: Paul, an apostle, is writing to the churches of Galatia, where some people are trying to distort the gospel of Christ. So Paul tells them, brothers, the gospel I preached wasn't made up by some man. Now he's about to tell them where it DID come from.

cards.question: So where does Paul say he received the gospel he preached to the Galatians?

cards.text: Then Paul says, you've heard about my former way of life in Judaism. Oh, friend, I bet this is the part where a man clears his throat and studies the floor real hard.

cards.question: Back in his former way of life, what did Paul do to the church of God?

answers.text: Persecuted it and tried to destroy it
Joined it and taught its people
Left it alone and moved away

cards.question: Paul describes himself back in Judaism. He says he was extremely ___ for the traditions of his fathers.
True or false: Paul says that in Judaism he was falling behind most of the people his own age.

cards.text: But then God steps in, the God who set Paul apart from his mother's womb and called him by His grace. Paul's sprinting full speed the wrong direction, and God had dibs on him since the WOMB!

cards.question: God was pleased to reveal His Son in Paul, the man who used to persecute the church. What was that for?

answers.text: So Paul might preach Him among the Gentiles
So Paul might guard the traditions of his fathers
So Paul might serve Him quietly in the temple

cards.text: So Paul's just gotten the biggest news of his life, straight from God. Friend, when I get big news, I'm polling six people before the timer even dings, so what does Paul do?

cards.question: True or false: Paul rushes to consult with people and goes straight up to Jerusalem to the apostles who came before him.
Instead of heading to Jerusalem, where does Paul go?

answers.text: Into Arabia and later back to Damascus
Into Egypt and later back to Joppa
Into Macedonia and later back to Antioch

cards.text: Only after three years does Paul go up to Jerusalem, and he stays fifteen days. THREE YEARS, friend, and I've seen bakers who can't wait three minutes for a cookie to cool!

cards.question: When Paul finally goes up to Jerusalem, who does he go to confer with?
Cephas is Peter, one of Jesus' apostles (Matthew 10:2; John 1:42). True or false: the only other apostle Paul sees on that trip is James, the Lord's brother.

cards.text: Then Paul stops and says, "I assure you before God that what I am writing to you is no lie." When a man says THAT in the middle of his travel log, you put the cookie down and LISTEN.

cards.question: After his time in Jerusalem, where does Paul later go?

answers.text: The regions of Syria and Cilicia
The regions of Macedonia and Achaia
The regions of Galatia and Phrygia

cards.question: Paul is off in Syria and Cilicia now. True or false: the churches of Judea know Paul personally.

cards.text: So the churches in Judea only know Paul by the story going around about him. And friend, it's the kind of news that makes a whole group chat go, "WAIT. WHAT?"

cards.question: Here's the story the churches of Judea hear: The man who formerly ___ us is now preaching the faith he once tried to ___.
When the churches of Judea hear that story about Paul, what do they do?

answers.text: They glorify God because of Paul
They send men to question Paul
